# Bibi Sipra, CPA

> Big 4-trained US corporate tax professional and EY alum. Career focus: US corporate tax leadership for multinational corporations in Southeast Asia.

## Professional profile
- Name: Bibi Sipra, CPA.
- Professional focus: US corporate tax compliance, ASC 740 income tax provision, US GAAP tax accounting, SEC reporting support and multinational reporting.
- EY experience: Tax Staff through Tax Senior Manager, 2016–2023; Global Compliance and Reporting.
- Selected project: led two teams of Deloitte tax professionals (11 and 8 members) on more than 495 multistate corporate tax returns using ONESOURCE Income Tax. This describes a project, not an assertion of permanent Deloitte employment.
- Credentials and education: CPA; MBA and bachelor's studies in business management and accounting at the University of South Florida. No license jurisdiction, license number or current license-status assertion is supplied here.

## Core competencies
- Big 4 corporate tax; US federal and multistate direct income tax.
- ASC 740; income tax provision; US GAAP; valuation allowance analysis; deferred tax scheduling.
- Large-scale multinational tax compliance; international tax provision; consolidation of foreign entity data.
- SEC reporting support; cross-border and cross-functional team leadership; ONESOURCE Income Tax; project management.

## Target roles and regions
- Target roles: US Corporate Tax Director, Senior Tax Manager, US Tax Accounting Lead and regional tax leadership roles with substantial US tax responsibilities.
- Target organizations: multinational corporations (MNCs), US MNC regional headquarters and APAC regional tax hubs.
- Target locations: Singapore; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Bangkok, Thailand; Jakarta, Indonesia.
- US-based and open to expat relocation. Target locations are career preferences, not existing offices, current employment locations or work-authorization claims.
- Full-time priority; contingent and fractional opportunities also considered; onsite or remote depending on the role.

## Role-fit discussions
Recruiters may include US inbound/outbound international tax, Subpart F, GILTI, FDII, Pillar Two / BEPS, cross-border structuring or M&A tax due diligence in a role brief. These are potential mandate topics, not independently established specialist competencies. Discuss the required depth and relevant experience directly with Bibi.
